question: If x > 1, and x²+(1)/(x²)=2sqrt5, what is the value of x⁴-(1)/(x⁴)?
solution:
**Given :-**

x² + 1/x² = 2√ 5

**Formula used:-**

A² - B² = (A+B)(A - B)

**Calculation:-**

 x2 + 1/x2 = 2√ 5 

Add both sides 2 

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 2√ 5 

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 + 2= 2√ 5 +2 

⇒ (x +1/x)² = 2√ 5 +2 

⇒ (x +1/x) = (2√ 5 +2)¹/²......(!)

Similarly, subtract 2 on both sides and we get 

⇒(x - 1/x)2 = 2√ 5 - 2 

⇒ (x - 1/x) = (2√ 5 - 2)¹/².........(2)

As per the question,

⇒ x⁴ - 1/x⁴ 

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)( x2 - 1/x2)

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) (x -y)(x+y).....(3)

Put all the values in equation(3) 

⇒ (2√ 5) (2√ 5 +2)1/2 (2√ 5 - 2)1/2 

⇒ (2√ 5)[ (2√ 5)² - (2)²]¹/² 

⇒ (2√ 5)( 20 - 4)¹/² 

​

⇒ (2√ 5) × 4 = 8 √ 5

** ∴ The required answer is 8√ 5.**
